absent.note: The data sheet has no absolute-maximum table. Its PERFORMANCE table's Short time overload row (page 3) refers to an external web tool (JoulWizard) for overload performance instead of stating a figure, and note (4) of TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS (page 2) says the part is limited by power and energy dissipation rather than voltage and is not ESD sensitive; no stress limit is given as a number.

description: 20 mohm +/-1% metal-strip current-sense resistor, 1206, 1 W at 70 degC, +/-75 ppm/K (Vishay Dale WSLP)
notes: Benchmark use: buck-3v3 /r_sns (R10, current-sense shunt). Series data sheet record: every value is the WSLP1206 entry of the data sheet's tables. Two terminals. The dimension drawing's 'typical sensing traces' are a PCB layout recommendation for a Kelvin connection to the two pads, not separate sense terminals, so the part has two pins and the benchmark's Kelvin routing is a layout matter. voltage_rating is the vendor's Maximum working voltage, which for this series is the formula (P x R)^1/2 with no fixed cap. For this part sqrt(1.0 W x 0.020 ohm) = sqrt(0.02) V is irrational; it is written 0.1414 V, truncated (never rounded up) so the recorded maximum is never above the vendor's. It is the same limit as the power rating, restated as a voltage. Not recorded because no check reads them: the element TCR (< 20 ppm/degC, the alloy alone; the component TCR including the copper terminals is the one recorded), the inductance and thermal EMF feature claims, the PERFORMANCE test limits and the pulse capability tool. The data sheet carries an 'Upgrade for Wider Resistance Range to WFM' banner on every page; it is not a lifecycle statement and no lifecycle status for this part number appears in the data sheet or on the vendor's WSLP product page (vishay.com/en/product/30122, read 2026-10-24), so the record says unknown. The MPN is checked against the data sheet's part number grammar and the WSLP1206 +/-1.0 % range (0.0005 to 0.05 ohm); no vendor page for the exact MPN was read.

pins.description: Terminal 1. The part is symmetric; which terminal is 1 carries no meaning.
